senses.definition: A line at the beginning of a document (such as a newspaper article) stating the place of origin and typically the date, and often written in capital letters.
senses.example: Other bits of furniture include the dateline, which says where a journalist is reporting from – historically with the date of dispatch, eg “Buenos Aires, 1 March.”

senses.definition: To attach a dateline to a particular document.
senses.example: He datelined the entry: "Oxford Mississippi, 27 January, 1926."
